title: Tôi bị tính tiền hai lần
pronunciation: toy bee ting tyen hai lun
summary: For telling a desk, shop, hotel, or app counter that you were charged twice.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use it with the receipt, bank alert, app screen, or room bill visible.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say the phrase once, then show the two charges before explaining anything else.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi bị tính tiền hai lần
phrases.pronunciation: toy bee ting tyen hai lun

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Tôi bị means I was; tính tiền means charged; hai lần means twice.

breakdown.vietnamese: Tôi bị tính tiền hai lần

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Wrong amount, this is not my receipt, and wrong bill phrases help with nearby payment mistakes.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi đã bị tính sai số tiền
phrases.english: I was charged the wrong amount
phrases.pronunciation: Toi da bi tinh sai so tien

phrases.vietnamese: Biên lai này không phải của tôi
phrases.pronunciation: Bien lai nay khong phai cua toi

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi đưa nhầm hóa đơn cho bạn
phrases.english: I gave you the wrong bill
phrases.pronunciation: Toi dua nham hoa don cho ban

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotel reception, restaurants, ticket counters, ride desks, shops, and service counters.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Two visible charges make this much easier to solve. Keep the dates, amounts, and card screen ready.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Receipt, refund, cancel the card payment, manager, and report phrases cover the next recovery step.
